name: talking-legend
description: LLM-native game: React frontend + TypeScript backend, world evolution and NPC dialogue powered by LLM

scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,fe "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: npm run stop && npm run build && node scripts/start-backend.mjs --clean
scripts.hot: npm run stop && npm run build && npm run dev
